تستقطرين (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِرِينَ (tastaqṭirīna) /tas.taq.tˤi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# تُسْتَقْطَرِينَ (tustaqṭarīna) /tus.taq.tˤa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
